description: 8 retrieval probes for Alamofire — MIT-licensed canonical Swift HTTP networking library. Targets idiomatic Swift idioms: @unchecked Sendable conformance, generic structs with where clauses, generic final classes constrained by associated types, open class hierarchies. Tree-sitter-swift WASM grammar restored via .sweet-search/grammars/tree-sitter-swift.wasm override (0.7.2 build from alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift 0.7.2-pypi release — newer than the 0.4.0 shipped in tree-sitter-wasms@0.1.13, which crashed V8 turboshaft wasm tier-up on Node 25.8.1).

probes.query: how does alamofire manage the lifecycle and cancellation of an in-flight network request
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `public class Request: @unchecked Sendable` (line 29) is the abstract base class managing request state machine (initialized → resumed → suspended → cancelled → finished) and task association via RequestTaskMap

probes.query: build a multipart/form-data upload body with file fields and form fields in alamofire
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `open class MultipartFormData` (line 45) constructs RFC 7578 multipart bodies for file uploads — appends file URLs, data, and stream bodies with content-disposition + content-type headers

probes.query: monitor network reachability changes on cellular vs wifi in swift
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `open class NetworkReachabilityManager: @unchecked Sendable` (line 41) wraps SystemConfiguration's SCNetworkReachability to report .reachable(.ethernetOrWiFi)/.reachable(.cellular)/.notReachable transitions

Symbol-anchored: `open class Session: @unchecked Sendable` (line 30) is the URLSession-backed coordinator that vends DataRequest / DownloadRequest / UploadRequest instances and runs them on its internal serial rootQueue

probes.query: AFError typed error cases in alamofire
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored: `public enum AFError: Error, Sendable` (line 33) is the top-level error enum with nested .invalidURL, .parameterEncodingFailed(reason), .responseValidationFailed(reason), .responseSerializationFailed(reason) etc.
Symbol-anchored: `open class RetryPolicy: @unchecked Sendable, RequestInterceptor` (line 29) — the canonical retry policy implementation with exponential backoff and configurable retry conditions

probes.query: await an alamofire request as an async value with cancellation propagation
probes.notes: Grammar edge case: `public struct DataTask<Value>: Sendable where Value: Sendable` (line 115) — generic struct with same-type where clause repeating the conformance. Tests tree-sitter-swift's handling of `where Generic: Conformance` on a struct declaration

Grammar edge case: `public final class AuthenticationInterceptor<AuthenticatorType>: RequestInterceptor, Sendable where AuthenticatorType: Authenticator` (line 160) — generic final class with multiple protocol conformances AND a where-clause on the generic parameter. Tests grammar handling of `final class X<T>: A, B where T: C`
